findings.title: B3 PointToPoint editor ships map-pin only, no address autocomplete
findings.detail: The B3 AC describes the PointToPoint form as 'address-autocomplete + map-pin point pickers + radii'. RouteEditor ships the lazy PinPickerMap (click + draggable marker) + a coordinate status line + radii, but no address text/autocomplete field. The backend RouteAdminDto/CreateRouteRequest carry only fromLat/fromLng/toLat/toLng (no address fields), so an address input would be a pure UI locating aid the backend never persists. The developer flagged this as a conscious deviation.
findings.recommendation: Accept as a minor follow-up. If letter-of-AC is required, promote a shared AddressAutocomplete wrapping the shared getGeoSuggest and set the pin from a search result (do NOT reuse features/customer/AddressAutocomplete — cross-feature).

findings.title: Inline style object on the move-button column and the days fieldset
findings.detail: RoutesTab line 167 uses style={{ display:'flex', flexDirection:'column', gap:2 }} and RouteEditor line 283 uses style={{ border:'none', padding:0, margin:0 }} instead of styled-components with theme tokens. Minor and uses a raw px gap (2). Not a functional issue and does not bypass a color token.
findings.recommendation: Optionally move these into styled wrappers using theme.spacing tokens for consistency with the rest of the file.

Touch targets via theme.touchTargets.min on all buttons/inputs/chips; vitest-axe on RoutesTab + PlacesTab per the handoff tests. No tsconfig.tsbuildinfo staged. No Windows case-collision. Only two LOW findings, both cosmetic/scope.
ac_deviation_verdict: ACCEPTABLE minor follow-up — does NOT block an AC. B3 P2P ships map-pin-only (no address autocomplete). Rationale: (1) RouteAdminDto/CreateRouteRequest carry only lat/lng, no address field, so the pin sets exactly the coordinates the backend stores; an address box would be a non-persisted locating convenience. (2) The AC#4 E2E acceptance flow creates a ZONE route (FromZone dropdown), not a P2P route, so no AC-level test depends on P2P address autocomplete. (3) B4's AC explicitly makes address autocomplete OPTIONAL, and PlaceEditor's plain address field + map pin is fully compliant there. The developer correctly avoided reusing the customer AddressAutocomplete (cross-feature) rather than shipping a rule violation. Recommend tracking the shared-AddressAutocomplete promotion as a clean follow-up WI; merge laneB6b now.
